summary_hint: Signed borrower authorization permitting <lender/broker> to verify <authorized categories>, executed <signature date>, valid <duration>.

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: disambiguator — distinguishes this from the counseling authorization (056) and other consents

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose consent this is (flattened; primary borrower)

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — co-borrower consent on a joint form (flattened from person[])

typed_core.name: lender_or_broker_name
typed_core.why: identity — the authorized recipient of released information

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity/linkage — attaches consent to the subject property (flattened from address)

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: linkage — attaches document to the loan file (confidential identifier)

typed_core.name: authorized_information_categories
typed_core.why: processor — what verification/release scope was granted (degraded from enum[]; joined string)

typed_core.name: reverification_before_and_after_closing
typed_core.why: processor — whether re-verification post-closing is permitted (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: copy_and_document_release_permission
typed_core.why: processor — whether a photocopy suffices as an original (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: authorization_duration_or_expiration
typed_core.why: processor — whether the authorization is still valid through closing

typed_core.name: accuracy_and_completeness_certification
typed_core.why: processor — the borrower's certification that data is accurate (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: duty_to_update_information
typed_core.why: processor — acknowledgment of duty to report changes (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: privacy_or_information_use_acknowledgment
typed_core.why: processor — privacy consent presence (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_present
typed_core.why: execution/identity — whether the borrower signed (degraded from signature)

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_date
typed_core.why: execution — when signed; recency and validity
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the signature date precisely; a stale or undated authorization is the common defect.

rejected.name: party_names / party_addresses
rejected.reason: generic; superseded by typed borrower/lender names and property_address

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: rarely a standardized numbered form here

rejected.name: notary_block, witness_or_notary, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: not required to be notarized; no consumer

encoding_variations: Authorization scope is stated as a checklist of categories (employment, bank, tax, credit) or as prose; authorized_information_categories captures either as a joined string — note the degradation from enum[].
Booleans here are consent flags encoded as checkboxes, initials, or prose ('I authorize...'); capture the underlying phrase in the snippet since they degrade to strings.

open_questions.q: Enum/boolean degradation — several consent flags degrade to strings for lack of a bool/enum coercer.
options: accept string degradation and rely on the snippet
open_questions.recommendation: accept string degradation and rely on the snippet; revisit only if a rule needs a typed boolean (e.g. 'authorization must permit post-closing re-verification')

open_questions.q: Signatures flattened vs nested — flattened to present/date for up to two borrowers.
open_questions.recommendation: flatten; revisit as a nested list only if a rule must address more than two signers individually

notes: No rules read this document today, so there is no rule floor; this is a compliance/consent artifact whose value is proving the borrower signed, what they authorized, and when.
Prompt hint (doc-level): this is a consent/certification form, not a data source — the headline is whether it is signed, dated, and in scope, not financial figures.
Prompt hint (doc-level): distinguish from the counseling authorization (doc 056): this is a general information-release and certification, not a HUD counseling consent.

PII: loan_number is a confidential identifier flagged for review. No SSN/DOB/account-number field appears in this catalog; if a signature block carries an SSN in practice it must be promoted to a typed masked field rather than left to the catch-all.

Ambiguity: loan_number's why is 'linkage' (classified identity). borrower_signature_date's why is 'execution' — not one of the five reason classes; classified as processor (recency/validity of the signed consent).
